title: Seoul in December: Christmas Lights and New Year's Eve
summary: Plan a warm Christmas lights walk in Seoul and know what to expect at the Bosingak bell on New Year’s Eve.

slides.title: Cold After Dark? Dress Warmly
slides.sub: December evenings call for warm layers
slides.voice: Seoul in December gets icy after dark. Dress warmly.
slides.photo_query: Seoul winter night street cold weather

slides.title: Pack Four Warm Essentials
slides.sub: Padded coat, hat, gloves, heat packs
slides.voice: Wear a padded coat, hat, and gloves. Grab heat packs at a convenience store.
slides.photo_query: winter travel clothing padded coat hat gloves heat packs Korea

slides.title: Walk The Central Lights
slides.voice: Walk from Myeongdong to Cheonggyecheon, then Gwanghwamun. It’s about two kilometres, or two hours with stops.

slides.title: Get There Before Eleven
slides.voice: At Bosingak, the bell rings thirty-three times at midnight. Arrive well before eleven; expect big crowds.
